setup: LLM tool-calling benchmark: 30 curated HEMS prompts mapped to JSON tool calls
C1_note: Keyword parser baseline (70% tool acc, 77.78% F1); rule baseline for parsing, not control (p.10)
C2_note: Tool accuracy/F1/latency only; no control metric (p.10)
C3_note: No ambiguous/adversarial or off-nominal tests reported (p.10)
C4_note: Models named, full prompt in appendix (p.20), dataset in supplement; single run, no variance (p.10)
C5_note: Tool-name accuracy and parameter F1 over 30 prompts per model (p.10, Table 3)
C6_note: Regex fallback fills missing params; tool choice unchecked; not challenged (p.13)
llm_latency: 0.703 s Phi-3 Mini; 1.634-2.801 s other LLMs (p.10)
llm_model: Phi-3 Mini (Ollama); also Gemini 2.5 Flash, Llama 3 8B, Gemma 7B
key_result: Phi-3 Mini 96.67% tool accuracy, 81.48% parameter F1, 0.703 s; Gemini 100% but 37.29% F1 (p.10)

setup: Integrated LLM-MPC HEMS: LLM invokes economic MPC/appliance tool on simulated PV-battery home
C1_note: Price-blind and heuristic price-aware rule controllers; no arm isolating LLM vs direct MPC call (p.7-8, p.14)
C2_note: Net bill, grid import/export, self-consumption/sufficiency, SoC at 18:00 (p.14, p.16, p.18)
C3_note: Seasons and stochastic loads only; no forecast error, fault or disturbance test (p.16)
C4_note: 7 days x 3 seasons mean +/- SD across days; MPC params Table 2, prompt p.20; LLM not repeated (p.10, p.16)
C5_note: No closed-loop LLM decision rate; single dishwasher example (p.15)
C6_note: No gate on tool choice; no bad proposals injected (p.13)
loop_timing: MPC 15-min interval, 8 h horizon, 1.82 s solve (p.10, p.13)
key_result: MPC bill -19.26 vs price-blind -15.23 but heuristic -25.69 rupees/day (p.14); monsoon 8 h MPC 2.70 vs 10.35 (p.17)
limitation: Simulation-only, idealized PV/battery; hardware validation left to future work (p.18)
